tooling.message:
docs(guidance): read the plan template and the skills in full, from their files

## Intent

The second explainer run fetched the plan template and the skills with a tool that returned summaries. It never had the plan's tasks and checkpoints, asked for the plan before researching and created the app right after. State the method of reading in the guidance, not a command.

## Key changes

- The quick path in llms.txt, AGENTS.md, lernapps-app and the plan template say how to read: download the file, read it complete and unchanged, never work from a summary.
- Explore starts by installing the skills, and the skills are read from where they were installed.
- AGENTS.md stays within its limit of 350 words.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same intent: app-templates#20 limits an app's type check to src/.

## Intent

An explainer app's vue-tsc checked the runtime's build and test code in node_modules and failed with 19 errors on Node's modules. app-templates fixes the template; pin that fix.

tooling.message:
fix(create): keep the installed skills, and create only from the confirmed plan

## Intent

The second explainer run never read the plan template in full and created the app right after a plan was confirmed. Without a plan file, create silently wrote one in the phase code, which hid that Explore and Plan were skipped. And the new first task of Explore, installing the skills, made create refuse the folder. Let create keep the installed skills, and create only from a confirmed plan.

## Key changes

- create accepts exactly what installing the tooling's skills writes: the lock file and each locked skill's folder or link. It keeps them, writes the content guide beside them and ignores them in git, like node_modules; the app's own content guide stays committed.
- Without a plan, create refuses and says to start one from the plan template, downloaded complete and unchanged; with a plan still in Explore or Plan it says the creator must confirm it first; with another archetype than asked it names both.
- The explainer's end-to-end test adds a valid component and runs the commit's part of the check, which failed on the previous app-templates pin.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same intent: app-templates#20, whose type-check fix this pull request pins.

app-templates.message:
fix(explainer): the app's type check reads src/ only, and the client reaches no Node code

## Intent

In an explainer app with a component, vue-tsc checked every .ts file of the app and, through vite.config.ts and e2e/, the runtime's build and test code in node_modules. That is Node code, which the app's browser types cannot check: 19 errors for an app whose own code had none. Check only the app's own code.

## Key changes

- The template's tsconfig includes src/ only, so vue-tsc checks the app's own code and components with the tooling's settings.
- vite.config.ts, playwright.config.ts and e2e/ stay checked by vp check, which reports only the app's own files.
- The component types the client reached through a Node module now live in a plain content module, so nothing src/ reaches needs Node.
- The quiz is unchanged: it has no components, so vue-tsc does not run there.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same intent: tooling#69 pins this commit, and its guidance and generator changes.
